/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.en:
Sends the e-mail confirmation link again. The answer is 202 `accepted` whatever the address, so that it never tells whether an account or a signup uses it.

A request acts at most once every 5 minutes per address. A signup waiting with that address gets its 24 hours again, whether or not another account uses the address, so that its username stays held as long in both cases. A link is sent only for that signup when the address has no account (a new link, valid 24 hours, replaces the previous one), or for an active, unconfirmed account with that address.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_mail` (10 per hour per client).
/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.text:
Saadab e-posti kinnituslingi uuesti. Vastus on olenemata aadressist 202 `accepted`, nii et see ei reeda kunagi, kas aadressi kasutab mõni konto või registreerumine.

Päring toimib aadressi kohta kõige rohkem kord 5 minuti jooksul. Selle aadressiga ootel registreerumine saab oma 24 tundi uuesti, olenemata sellest, kas aadressi kasutab mõni teine konto, nii et selle kasutajanimi jääb mõlemal juhul sama kauaks kinni. Link saadetakse ainult sellele registreerumisele, kui aadressil pole kontot (uus, 24 tundi kehtiv link asendab eelmise), või selle aadressiga aktiivsele kinnitamata kontole.

**Piirangud:** `auth`, seejärel `auth_mail` (10 tunnis kliendi kohta).

/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.en: `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1`: the database stayed locked while the account was looked up or the link of an unconfirmed account was stored (the renewal of a waiting signup is best effort and never fails the request); the address's 5 minutes start all the same, so a new request within them does nothing. `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1verify-email~1resend/post.text: `server_busy` koos `retryAfter: 1`: andmebaas jäi lukustatuks konto otsimise või kinnitamata konto lingi salvestamise ajal (ootel registreerumise uuendamine tehakse võimaluse korral ega põhjusta kunagi päringu ebaõnnestumist); aadressi 5 minutit algavad sellegipoolest, nii et nende jooksul tehtud uus päring ei tee midagi. `timeout`. Samuti `server_busy` väärtusega `retryAfter` 2 kuni 5, kui server on tööga kaugele maha jäänud (vt sissejuhatust): päringut ei täidetud.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/des.en:
Sends a password reset link, valid for one hour, which opens the page `/reset-password`. The answer is 202 `accepted` whatever the address. A link goes only to an active account, at most once every 5 minutes per address. A Google-only account sets its first password this way.

Password recovery has the strictest limits of the API, all counted for the whole server: 3 requests per hour (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_HOUR`) and 10 per 24 hours (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_DAY`) per client (an IPv4 address or an IPv6 /64), 3 times those numbers per IPv6 /48, on top of the `auth` limit (20 per 10 minutes) and of the one mail per address every 5 minutes. Neither the 202 nor the 429 tells whether an account uses the address. Setting the new password has its own limit (`auth_reset`).

**Limits:** `auth`, `auth_forgot`, then `auth_forgot_day`.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/des.text:
Saadab ühe tunni kehtiva parooli lähtestamise lingi, mis avab lehe `/reset-password`. Vastus on olenemata aadressist 202 `accepted`. Link saadetakse ainult aktiivsele kontole, kõige rohkem kord 5 minuti jooksul aadressi kohta. Ainult Google'iga sisse logiv konto määrab nii oma esimese parooli.

Parooli taastamisel on API kõige rangemad piirangud, mida kõiki arvestatakse kogu serveri peale: 3 päringut tunnis (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_HOUR`) ja 10 päringut 24 tunni jooksul (`AUTH_FORGOT_PER_DAY`) kliendi kohta (IPv4-aadress või IPv6 /64), IPv6 /48 kohta 3 korda rohkem, lisaks piirangule `auth` (20 päringut 10 minuti jooksul) ja ühele e-kirjale aadressi kohta iga 5 minuti järel. Ei 202 ega 429 reeda, kas aadressi kasutab mõni konto. Uue parooli määramisel on oma piirang (`auth_reset`).

**Piirangud:** `auth`, `auth_forgot`, seejärel `auth_forgot_day`.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/res.en: `server_busy` with `retryAfter: 1`: the database stayed locked while the account was looked up or the link was stored; the address's 5 minutes start all the same, so a new request within them sends no link. `timeout`. Also `server_busy` with `retryAfter` 2 to 5 when the server is far behind (see the introduction): the request was not run.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1forgot/post/res.text: `server_busy` koos `retryAfter: 1`: andmebaas jäi lukustatuks konto otsimise või lingi salvestamise ajal; aadressi 5 minutit algavad sellegipoolest, nii et nende jooksul tehtud uus päring linki ei saada. `timeout`. Samuti `server_busy` väärtusega `retryAfter` 2 kuni 5, kui server on tööga kaugele maha jäänud (vt sissejuhatust): päringut ei täidetud.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/summ.en: Set a new password with a reset link's token

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/desc.en:
Sets a new password with the token of a reset link (the page `/reset-password` does the same). The new password follows the rules of registration.

The reset has these effects, in one transaction (all of them, or none): it revokes every session and cancels a pending e-mail change; the other reset links of the account stop working; the address counts as confirmed (the link proved it); the owner gets a mail. Two-step verification is not touched. After a password hash queue error, a 503 or a 500, nothing changed: the old password and the sessions stay, and the link stays valid.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_reset` (10 per hour per client, 30 per IPv6 /48, shared with the page: each attempt hashes a password).
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/desc.text:
Määrab lähtestamislingi tokeniga uue parooli (leht `/reset-password` teeb sama). Uus parool peab vastama registreerumise reeglitele.

Lähtestamisel on ühes transaktsioonis (kõik või mitte ükski) järgmised mõjud: see tühistab kõik seansid ja tühistab ootel e-posti aadressi muutmise; konto teised lähtestamislingid lakkavad töötamast; aadress loetakse kinnitatuks (link tõestas selle); omanik saab e-kirja. Kaheastmelist autentimist see ei puuduta. Pärast paroolide räsimise järjekorra viga, 503 või 500 pole midagi muutunud: vana parool ja seansid jäävad alles ning link jääb kehtima.

**Piirangud:** `auth`, seejärel `auth_reset` (10 tunnis kliendi kohta, 30 IPv6 /48 kohta, ühine lehega: iga katse räsib parooli).

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.en: The password is changed and every session is signed out.
/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: Parool on muudetud ja kõik seansid on välja logitud.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `invalid_token`: link on kehtetu, kasutatud või aegunud või saadeti aadressile, mida kontol enam pole. `weak_password` (koos väljaga `reason`). `invalid_request`, `invalid_json`.

/paths/~1auth~1password~1reset/post/resp.text: `server_busy`: paroolide räsimise järjekord või andmebaas jäi lukustatuks (`retryAfter: 1`, midagi ei muutunud). `timeout`. /paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/d.en:
Starts a Google sign-in attempt for the PKCE challenge and the port of the game's listener on `127.0.0.1`. The answer gives the Google URL to open in the system browser and the attempt's `state`; the attempt is valid for 10 minutes.

`authUrl` holds `client_id`, `redirect_uri` (built from `redirectPort` and the server's origin tag), `response_type=code`, `scope=openid email profile`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge` (S256 of the server's own verifier for Google) with `code_challenge_method=S256`, and `prompt=select_account`. The game checks it before it opens it (see the tag description).

**Limit:** `sso_start`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1start/post/d.text:
Alustab Google'iga sisselogimise katset PKCE väljakutse ja mängu kuulaja pordiga aadressil `127.0.0.1`. Vastus annab süsteemi brauseris avatava Google'i URL-i ja katse väärtuse `state`; katse kehtib 10 minutit.

`authUrl` sisaldab parameetreid `client_id`, `redirect_uri` (koostatud väärtusest `redirectPort` ja serveri päritolutunnusest), `response_type=code`, `scope=openid email profile`, `state`, `nonce`, `code_challenge` (serveri enda, Google'i jaoks mõeldud verifitseerija S256) koos `code_challenge_method=S256` ning `prompt=select_account`. Mäng kontrollib seda enne avamist (vt jaotise kirjeldust).

**Piirang:** `sso_start`.

Starts a Google sign-in attempt of a website for the PKCE challenge of its page. The answer is the same as for the game: the Google URL to navigate to, and the attempt's `state`; the attempt is valid for 10 minutes. Offered when `GET /info` says `sso.googleWeb: true`.

`authUrl` holds the website's `client_id` and `redirect_uri=GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI`, with the same other parameters as for the game. The page checks it before it navigates to it (see **On a website** in the tag description).

Alustab veebisaidi Google'iga sisselogimise katset selle lehe PKCE väljakutsega. Vastus on sama mis mängule: Google'i URL, millele liikuda, ja katse väärtus `state`; katse kehtib 10 minutit. Saadaval, kui `GET /info` ütleb `sso.googleWeb: true`.

`authUrl` sisaldab veebisaidi parameetreid `client_id` ja `redirect_uri=GOOGLE_WEB_REDIRECT_URI` ning ülejäänud parameetreid samamoodi nagu mängu puhul. Leht kontrollib seda enne sellele liikumist (vt jaotise kirjeldusest lõiku **Veebisaidil**).

**Piirang:** `sso_start`, ühine mängu alustamisega.

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/su.en: Link Google to an existing account with its password
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/su.text: Seo Google olemasoleva kontoga selle parooli abil

/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/de.en:
After `finish` answered `needsPassword`: links Google to the existing account with that account's password, typed in the game. The answer (200) is a session (the link is stored and the player signed in), or, when two-step verification is on, `{ mfaRequired, mfaToken, expiresIn }`: continue with `POST /auth/login/mfa`, and the link is stored only when a code passes there.

A wrong password leaves the ticket usable, for 5 tries in all. A try is taken just before the password is checked: a 429 `too_many_attempts` or a 428 `pow_required` takes none, while a refusal of the password hash queue (503 `server_busy`, 429 `rate_limited`) has taken one and counts as a failure of the account. The failure delay is the same counter as `POST /auth/login`.

**Limit:** `auth` (with its IPv6 /48 count). **Proof of work:** as for `POST /auth/login`.
/paths/~1auth~1sso~1google~1link/post/de.text:
Kui `finish` vastas `needsPassword`: seob Google'i olemasoleva kontoga selle konto parooli abil, mis sisestatakse mängus. Vastus (200) on seanss (seos salvestatakse ja mängija logitakse sisse) või, kui kaheastmeline autentimine on sees, `{ mfaRequired, mfaToken, expiresIn }`: jätkake otspunktiga `POST /auth/login/mfa` ja seos salvestatakse alles siis, kui kood seal kontrolli läbib.

Vale parooli korral jääb pilet kasutatavaks, kokku 5 katseks. Katse arvestatakse vahetult enne parooli kontrollimist: 429 `too_many_attempts` või 428 `pow_required` ei võta ühtegi katset, paroolide räsimise järjekorra keeldumine (503 `server_busy`, 429 `rate_limited`) aga on ühe katse juba võtnud ja läheb arvesse konto ebaõnnestumisena. Ebaõnnestumiste viivitus kasutab sama loendurit mis `POST /auth/login`.

**Piirang:** `auth` (koos selle IPv6 /48 loendusega). **Töötõend:** nagu otspunktil `POST /auth/login`.

/paths/~1auth~1sessions/get/description.en:
The account's active sessions (signed-in devices), the most recently used first. `current` marks the session making the request. `lastSeenAt` is updated at most every 5 minutes (later while the server is far behind); `expiresAt` is the absolute end, and the idle limit may end the session sooner.

/paths/~1account~1email/post/description.en:
Changes the account's e-mail address. `newEmail` is trimmed and lower-cased, then checked like a registration address.

**With e-mail confirmation** (the default): 202 `verification_sent`. A link valid for 24 hours goes to the new address; it opens `/confirm-email-change`, and the address changes only when the player presses that page's button. Until then, `GET /account/me` shows the new address as `pendingEmail`. A new request replaces the pending one; a password change or reset cancels it. At most one link goes to a given new address every 5 minutes, whoever asks (a request for the change already pending keeps the link sent earlier, which stays valid); the answer is the same. The current address gets a notice that a change to a masked address (`a***@example.org`) was requested. The answer and `pendingEmail` are the same when another account already uses the new address: no link is sent then, so that change never completes, and the owner of that address gets a notice (at most one per hour) instead.

When the link is confirmed, the address changes and counts as confirmed, the devices stay signed in, the links sent earlier (confirmation, password reset, other changes) stop working, and the former address is told, with the new one masked.

**Without e-mail confirmation** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): the address changes at once (200 `email_changed`), and the former address is told. If another account uses the address, the answer is 409 `email_taken`, and the owner of that address gets the notice.

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. `invalid_email` and `same_email` are checked before the password, so they count no failure. **Limits:** `reauth`, then `reauth_user`.
/paths/~1account~1email/post/description.text:
Muudab konto e-posti aadressi. Väärtuselt `newEmail` eemaldatakse algus- ja lõputühikud ning see teisendatakse väiketähtedeks, seejärel kontrollitakse seda nagu registreerumisel antud aadressi.

**E-posti kinnitusega** (vaikimisi): 202 `verification_sent`. Uuele aadressile saadetakse 24 tundi kehtiv link; see avab lehe `/confirm-email-change` ja aadress muutub alles siis, kui mängija vajutab sellel lehel nuppu. Seni näitab `GET /account/me` uut aadressi väljal `pendingEmail`. Uus päring asendab ootel päringu; parooli muutmine või lähtestamine tühistab selle. Antud uuele aadressile saadetakse kõige rohkem üks link iga 5 minuti jooksul, ükskõik kes seda küsib (päring juba ootel oleva muutmise kohta säilitab varem saadetud lingi, mis jääb kehtima); vastus on sama. Praegune aadress saab teavituse, et taotleti muutmist varjatud aadressile (`a***@example.org`). Vastus ja `pendingEmail` on samad, kui mõni teine konto juba kasutab uut aadressi: siis linki ei saadeta, nii et see muutmine ei jõua kunagi lõpule, ja selle aadressi omanik saab hoopis teavituse (kõige rohkem ühe tunnis).

Kui link kinnitatakse, aadress muutub ja loetakse kinnitatuks, seadmed jäävad sisse logituks, varem saadetud lingid (kinnitus, parooli lähtestamine, muud muutmised) lakkavad töötamast ja endist aadressi teavitatakse, kusjuures uus aadress on varjatud.

**E-posti kinnituseta** (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=false`): aadress muutub kohe (200 `email_changed`) ja endist aadressi teavitatakse. Kui mõni teine konto kasutab seda aadressi, on vastus 409 `email_taken` ja selle aadressi omanik saab teavituse.

**Uuesti autentimine:** parool ja kaheastmelise autentimise korral autentimisrakenduse kood või taastekood. `invalid_email` ja `same_email` kontrollitakse enne parooli, seega ei loeta neid ebaõnnestumiseks. **Piirangud:** `reauth`, seejärel `reauth_user`.

/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.en:
Everything the server keeps about the account, as one JSON file to save (`format` `scacelith-account-export`, `version` 1). The export records a security event (`account_exported`). The `notes` array of the document tells the player in plain English what is left out.

**Never in the export:** the password hash, the two-step verification secret and the recovery codes; any session or link token, or a hash of one; the anti-cheat's data (integrity level and score, anomalies, the analysis of the games, the weight of a report); the reports other players made about the player; the identities of moderators; other players' private data (opponents appear by their public name and rating, nothing tells whether another player was sanctioned, and no IP address that may be another person's is included).

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. **Limits:** `account_export` (5 per hour per player, for the whole server; every attempt counts, failed ones included; checked first), then `reauth` and `reauth_user`. **Time limit:** 60 seconds.
/paths/~1account~1export/post/descriptio.text:
Kõik, mida server konto kohta hoiab, ühe salvestatava JSON-failina (`format` `scacelith-account-export`, `version` 1). Eksport salvestab turvasündmuse (`account_exported`). Dokumendi massiiv `notes` ütleb mängijale lihtsas inglise keeles, mis on välja jäetud.

**Ekspordis pole kunagi:** parooli räsi, kaheastmelise autentimise salajast võtit ega taastekoode; ühtki seansi- ega lingitokenit ega selle räsi; sohitõrje andmeid (usaldusväärsuse taset ja skoori, anomaaliaid, partiide analüüsi, teate kaalu); teateid, mida teised mängijad on mängija kohta teinud; moderaatorite identiteeti; teiste mängijate privaatandmeid (vastased on näidatud avaliku nime ja reitinguga, miski ei ütle, kas mõnda teist mängijat on sanktsioneeritud, ja ühtki IP-aadressi, mis võib kuuluda teisele isikule, ei lisata).

**Uuesti autentimine:** parool ja kaheastmelise autentimise korral autentimisrakenduse kood või taastekood. **Piirangud:** `account_export` (5 tunnis mängija kohta kogu serveri peale; iga katse läheb arvesse, ka ebaõnnestunud; kontrollitakse esimesena), seejärel `reauth` ja `reauth_user`. **Ajapiirang:** 60 sekundit.

/paths/~1account~1delete/post/descriptio.en:
Deletes the account; this cannot be undone.

- Every session is revoked at once: the token gets 401 `invalid_token` from then on.
- The user name becomes `deleted#<id>`, in the account and in every game record.
- These are erased: the e-mail address, the password hash, the two-step secret and recovery codes, the sessions and link tokens, the Google link, the anti-cheat's integrity record, and the IP addresses stored with security events.
- Ratings and games are kept. Games stay readable under the anonymous name, and `GET /players/{username}` answers 404 for the former name.

**Re-authentication:** the password and, with two-step verification, an authenticator code or a recovery code. **Limits:** `reauth`, then `reauth_user`.
/paths/~1account~1delete/post/descriptio.text:
Kustutab konto; seda ei saa tagasi võtta.

- Kõik seansid tühistatakse kohe: tokenile vastatakse sellest hetkest alates 401 `invalid_token`.
- Kasutajanimeks saab `deleted#<id>`, nii kontos kui ka igas partiikirjes.
- Kustutatakse: e-posti aadress, parooli räsi, kaheastmelise autentimise salajane võti ja taastekoodid, seansid ja lingitokenid, Google'i seos, sohitõrje usaldusväärsuse kirje ning turvasündmustega salvestatud IP-aadressid.
- Reitingud ja partiid säilitatakse. Partiid jäävad anonüümse nime all loetavaks ja `GET /players/{username}` vastab endise nime korral 404.

**Uuesti autentimine:** parool ja kaheastmelise autentimise korral autentimisrakenduse kood või taastekood. **Piirangud:** `reauth`, seejärel `reauth_user`.

/paths/~1account~1games/get/description.en:
The signed-in player's games, newest first, filtered and paged, with the number of games matching the filter. Every query parameter is optional, and an empty value counts as absent.

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/summary.en: Download a game as a PGN file

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.en:
The same game as a PGN file: one game with `\n` line endings, and move text in lines under 80 columns. The answer is the same with or without a token.

Tags, in this order: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` or `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (the UTC start date), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (`*` for an aborted game), `UTCDate` and `UTCTime` (the start), `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` (the ratings at the start, or `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` and `BlackRatingDiff` (the changes, such as `+10` and `-10`, in every rated game, `+0` when the rating rules leave the rating where it was; a casual, custom or aborted game has neither), `TimeControl` (in seconds), `Termination` (a PGN standard value: `normal`; `time forfeit`, a flag fall, also when it ends in a draw; `abandoned`; `rules infraction`, a second illegal move or a fair-play forfeit; `unterminated`, an aborted game), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (the decimal id).

Each move carries `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: the mover's clock after the move and the time charged for it, in tenths of a second (truncated). A value is left out when the record lacks it. After the last move, the end reason follows in words, then the result.

**Limit:** `public_read` (per player with a token, per client without).
/paths/~1games~1{id}~1pgn/get/descriptio.text:
Sama partii PGN-failina: üks partii, reavahetused `\n` ja käikude tekst alla 80 veeru pikkustel ridadel. Vastus on sama nii tokeniga kui ka ilma.

Märgendid selles järjekorras: `Event` (`<SERVER_NAME> rated <category>` või `<SERVER_NAME> casual <category>`), `Site` (`SERVER_PUBLIC_HOST`), `Date` (alguskuupäev UTC järgi), `Round`, `White`, `Black`, `Result` (katkestatud partii puhul `*`), `UTCDate` ja `UTCTime` (algus), `WhiteElo` ja `BlackElo` (reitingud alguses või `-`), `WhiteRatingDiff` ja `BlackRatingDiff` (muutused, näiteks `+10` ja `-10`, igas reitinguga partiis; `+0`, kui reitingureeglid jätavad reitingu samaks; reitinguta, kohandatud või katkestatud partiis pole kumbagi), `TimeControl` (sekundites), `Termination` (PGN-standardi väärtus: `normal`; `time forfeit` – lipu langemine, ka siis, kui partii lõpeb viigiga; `abandoned`; `rules infraction` – teine reeglivastane käik või ausa mängu rikkumise eest määratud loobumiskaotus; `unterminated` – katkestatud partii), `PlyCount`, `ScacelithGameId` (ID kümnendarvuna).

Iga käigu juures on `{[%clk h:mm:ss.f] [%emt h:mm:ss.f]}`: käigu teinud mängija kell pärast käiku ja selle käigu eest arvestatud aeg, sekundi kümnendikes (kärbitud). Väärtus jäetakse välja, kui kirjes seda pole. Pärast viimast käiku tuleb sõnadega lõpu põhjus, seejärel tulemus.

**Piirang:** `public_read` (tokeniga mängija kohta, ilma tokenita kliendi kohta).

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1gif/get/summary.en: Download a game of this server as an animated GIF
/paths/~1games~1{id}~1gif/get/summary.text: Laadi selle serveri partii alla animeeritud GIF-ina

/paths/~1games~1{id}~1gif/get/descriptio.en:
The game as an animated GIF. The names and ratings are those of the game record (the ratings at the start, a deleted account as `deleted#<id>`), and so are the result and the ending (`Resignation`, `Loss on time`...).

The checks come in this order: `gif_disabled`, the picture options (`size`, `orientation`, `delay`, `coords`), the game id, the game, its length.

**Session required:** the quotas count per account. **Limits:** `gif` on every request; `gif_user_min`, `gif_user_hour`, `gif_ip_min` and `gif_ip_hour` only when the GIF has to be made (see the tag description). **Time limit:** `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` + `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` + 5 seconds (45 seconds by default).
/paths/~1games~1{id}~1gif/get/descriptio.text:
Partii animeeritud GIF-ina. Nimed ja reitingud on võetud partiikirjest (reitingud alguses, kustutatud konto kujul `deleted#<id>`), samuti tulemus ja lõpp (`Resignation`, `Loss on time`…).

Kontrollid toimuvad selles järjekorras: `gif_disabled`, pildi valikud (`size`, `orientation`, `delay`, `coords`), partii ID, partii, selle pikkus.

**Seanss on nõutav:** kvoote arvestatakse konto kaupa. **Piirangud:** `gif` igal päringul; `gif_user_min`, `gif_user_hour`, `gif_ip_min` ja `gif_ip_hour` ainult siis, kui GIF tuleb valmistada (vt jaotise kirjeldust). **Ajapiirang:** `GIF_QUEUE_TIMEOUT_MS` + `GIF_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS` + 5 sekundit (vaikimisi 45 sekundit).

/paths/~1gif/post/summary.en: Make an animated GIF of any game sent as PGN
/paths/~1gif/post/summary.text: Tee animeeritud GIF mis tahes PGN-ina saadetud partiist

/paths/~1gif/post/description.en:
The same picture as `GET /games/{id}/gif` for any game sent as PGN text: a game saved by the game, an export of another site, a game typed by hand. Only the first game of the text is used.

- The PGN reader takes what the game's own reader takes: every PGN that this server writes and the usual exports of other sites (comments, variations, NAGs and clock annotations are skipped; move numbers and SAN read leniently; a `FEN` tag gives the start position unless `SetUp` is `"0"`).
- The names and ratings come from the `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` and `BlackElo` tags. Accented letters lose their accents, other characters outside printable ASCII become `?`, and long names are cut (48 characters). The result comes from the `Result` tag, else from the end of the move text. The `Termination` tag is shown unless it is `normal`: the final position then tells the story (checkmate, stalemate).
- This endpoint checks its body itself: an unknown field or a missing or non-string `pgn` answers 400 `invalid_request` with `field`; a wrong option answers 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` must be a JSON number, `coords` a boolean; `null` is refused).

**Session required:** the quotas count per account. **Limits:** as for `GET /games/{id}/gif`. **Body limit:** 135,168 bytes, whatever `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (the PGN as a JSON string, its escapes included). **Time limit:** 45 seconds by default.
/paths/~1gif/post/description.text:
Sama pilt nagu `GET /games/{id}/gif` mis tahes partii kohta, mis on saadetud PGN-tekstina: mängus salvestatud partii, mõne teise saidi eksport, käsitsi sisestatud partii. Kasutatakse ainult teksti esimest partiid.

- PGN-i lugeja võtab vastu sama, mida mängu enda lugeja: iga PGN-i, mille see server kirjutab, ja teiste saitide tavalised ekspordid (kommentaarid, variandid, NAG-id ja kellaannotatsioonid jäetakse vahele; käigunumbreid ja SAN-i loetakse leebelt; märgend `FEN` annab algseisu, välja arvatud siis, kui `SetUp` on `"0"`).
- Nimed ja reitingud tulevad märgenditest `White`, `Black`, `WhiteElo` ja `BlackElo`. Diakriitikuga tähtedelt eemaldatakse diakriitikud, muud märgid väljaspool prinditavat ASCII-d muutuvad märgiks `?` ja pikad nimed lõigatakse lühemaks (48 märki). Tulemus tuleb märgendist `Result`, muidu käikude teksti lõpust. Märgendit `Termination` näidatakse, välja arvatud siis, kui see on `normal`: siis räägib lõppseis ise, mis juhtus (matt, patt).
- See otspunkt kontrollib oma keha ise: tundmatu väli või puuduv või mittestringiline `pgn` annab vastuseks 400 `invalid_request` koos väljaga `field`; vale valik annab vastuseks 400 `invalid_option` (`delayMs` peab olema JSON-arv, `coords` tõeväärtus; `null` lükatakse tagasi).

**Seanss on nõutav:** kvoote arvestatakse konto kaupa. **Piirangud:** nagu `GET /games/{id}/gif` puhul. **Keha suuruse piirang:** 135 168 baiti, olenemata väärtusest `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (PGN JSON-stringina koos paojadadega). **Ajapiirang:** vaikimisi 45 sekundit.

/paths/~1leaderboard/get/summary.en: Get the top players of a category

/paths/~1leaderboard/get/description.en:
The top 100 rated records of an official category with at least `minGames` (`PROVISIONAL_GAMES`) counted games, deleted accounts and confirmed cheaters left out. The server computes each board again at most every 10 seconds; `updatedAt` says when. One computation of a category runs at a time: meanwhile the other requests get the previous list, or wait for the computation when there is none yet.

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.

Ametliku kategooria 100 parimat reitingukirjet, millel on vähemalt `minGames` (`PROVISIONAL_GAMES`) arvesse läinud partiid; kustutatud kontod ja kinnitatud sohitegijad jäetakse välja. Server arvutab iga edetabeli uuesti mitte sagedamini kui iga 10 sekundi järel; `updatedAt` ütleb, millal. Kategooria kohta käib korraga ainult üks arvutus: selle ajal saavad teised päringud eelmise loendi või ootavad arvutuse lõppu, kui loendit veel pole.

**Piirangud:** ainult aadressipõhine kiht.

/paths/~1reports/post/summary.en: Report the opponent of a recent game

/paths/~1reports/post/description.en:
Reports the opponent of one of the player's own games that ended within the last 7 days. A report never changes a rating, a sanction or an integrity level by itself. It raises the review priority that moderators see, and, except for `abuse`, it asks for the engine analysis of the game.

A report of the same opponent for the same game gets the same answer and changes nothing; the answer never tells anything about the reported account. `GET /games/{id}` tells the game's players beforehand whether a report would be taken (`reportable`).

This endpoint checks its body itself, in the order `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: a failure answers 400 `invalid_request` without `field`. Fields it does not know are ignored.

**Limits:** `reports` (per player), then `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) reports per player in 24 hours (429 `report_limit`).
/paths/~1reports/post/description.text:
Teatab mängija enda partii vastasest, kui partii lõppes viimase 7 päeva jooksul. Teade ei muuda kunagi iseenesest reitingut, sanktsiooni ega usaldusväärsuse taset. See tõstab läbivaatamise prioriteeti, mida moderaatorid näevad, ja (välja arvatud `abuse` puhul) tellib partii mootorianalüüsi.

Teade samast vastasest sama partii kohta saab sama vastuse ega muuda midagi; vastus ei ütle kunagi midagi konto kohta, millest teatati. `GET /games/{id}` ütleb partii mängijatele ette, kas teade võetaks vastu (`reportable`).

See otspunkt kontrollib oma keha ise, järjekorras `gameId`, `reported`, `category`, `comment`: viga annab vastuseks 400 `invalid_request` ilma väljata `field`. Välju, mida see ei tunne, eiratakse.

**Piirangud:** `reports` (mängija kohta), seejärel `REPORTS_PER_DAY` (5) teadet mängija kohta 24 tunni jooksul (429 `report_limit`).

/paths/~1reports/post/responses/403/desc.en: `report_not_allowed`: not the opponent of the reporter in a game that ended within the last 7 days.
/paths/~1reports/post/responses/403/desc.text: `report_not_allowed`: pole teataja vastane partiis, mis lõppes viimase 7 päeva jooksul.

The page of a password reset link: the new password form (the password twice). The form posts to `POST /reset-password`.

/paths/~1reset-password/post/summary.en: Set a new password from the reset form

/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.en:
The form of the reset page; it does what `POST /auth/password/reset` does, in one transaction: every device is signed out, a pending e-mail change is cancelled, the other reset links stop working, the address counts as confirmed and the owner gets a mail.

The link is checked first, then that both passwords are the same, then the password rules. When the server is busy, the form comes back with `Retry-After` and the link stays valid.

**Limits:** `auth`, then `auth_reset` (shared with `POST /auth/password/reset`).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/description.text:
Lähtestamislehe vorm; see teeb sama, mida `POST /auth/password/reset`, ühes transaktsioonis: kõik seadmed logitakse välja, ootel e-posti aadressi muutmine tühistatakse, teised lähtestamislingid lakkavad töötamast, aadress loetakse kinnitatuks ja omanik saab e-kirja.

Kõigepealt kontrollitakse linki, seejärel seda, et mõlemad paroolid on samad, ja siis paroolireegleid. Kui server on hõivatud, tuleb vorm tagasi koos päisega `Retry-After` ja link jääb kehtima.

**Piirangud:** `auth`, seejärel `auth_reset` (ühine otspunktiga `POST /auth/password/reset`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/2.en: The password is changed, and every device signed out.
/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/2.text: Parool on muudetud ja kõik seadmed on välja logitud.

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.en: The form again with the error (the passwords differ, a weak password), the link is invalid, or the form is invalid (an HTML page).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.text: Vorm uuesti koos veaga (paroolid erinevad, nõrk parool), link on kehtetu või vorm on vigane (HTML-leht).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.en: The `auth` or `auth_reset` limit (an HTML page), the form again with `Retry-After` when this client has too many password hashes waiting (the link stays valid), or the per-address layer (JSON `rate_limited`).
/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/4.text: Piirang `auth` või `auth_reset` (HTML-leht), vorm uuesti koos päisega `Retry-After`, kui sellel kliendil ootab liiga palju paroolide räsimisi (link jääb kehtima), või aadressipõhine kiht (JSON `rate_limited`).

/paths/~1reset-password/post/responses/5.en: The form again with `Retry-After` when the server is busy (the password hash queue, or the database stayed locked); the link stays valid. /paths/~1readyz/get/summary.en: Check that the server accepts players
/paths/~1readyz/get/summary.text: Kontrolli, et server võtab mängijaid vastu

/paths/~1readyz/get/description.en:
Answers 200 `ready` when the server accepts players, and 503 `not_ready` while it starts or stops. `HEAD` works too. Any other method answers 405 `method_not_allowed` with `Allow: GET, HEAD` (`OPTIONS` included).

**Limits:** only the per-address layer.
/paths/~1readyz/get/description.text:
Vastab 200 `ready`, kui server võtab mängijaid vastu, ja 503 `not_ready`, kui see käivitub või seiskub. Töötab ka `HEAD`. Iga muu meetod saab vastuseks 405 `method_not_allowed` koos päisega `Allow: GET, HEAD` (ka `OPTIONS`).

**Piirangud:** ainult aadressipõhine kiht.

/paths/~1readyz/get/responses/503/descri.en: The server is starting or stopping.

/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.en: A session token (`sct_` followed by 43 base64url characters) from a sign-in answer, in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The prefix is exactly `Bearer` (case-sensitive) and one space; a value that does not have it, or a token that is not 1 to 512 printable ASCII characters, answers 401 `invalid_token` like any other invalid token. An empty header counts as no header.
/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth/d.text: Seansitoken (`sct_`, millele järgneb 43 base64url-märki) sisselogimisvastusest, päises `Authorization`: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Eesliide on täpselt `Bearer` (tõstutundlik) ja üks tühik; väärtus, millel seda pole, või token, mis ei koosne 1 kuni 512 prinditavast ASCII-märgist, saab vastuseks 401 `invalid_token` nagu iga teine kehtetu token. Tühi päis loetakse päise puudumiseks.

/components/parameters/GameId/descriptio.en: The game id, a positive decimal integer of at most 16 digits without leading zeros, below 2^53.
/components/parameters/GameId/descriptio.text: Partii ID: positiivne kümnendsüsteemis täisarv, kuni 16 numbrit, ilma eesnullideta, alla 2^53.

/components/parameters/SessionId/descrip.en: The session id, as `GET /auth/sessions` gives it, written without leading zeros (`03` is not session 3).
/components/parameters/SessionId/descrip.text: Seansi ID, nagu `GET /auth/sessions` selle annab, kirjutatuna ilma eesnullideta (`03` pole seanss 3).

/components/parameters/Username/descript.en: The player's user name, without regard to case. The server takes any name that is 2 to 24 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]` (the widest rule it ever allowed).
/components/parameters/Username/descript.text: Mängija kasutajanimi, tõstust arvestamata. Server võtab vastu iga nime, mis koosneb 2 kuni 24 märgist hulgast `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]` (kõige laiem reegel, mida server on kunagi lubanud).

/components/parameters/BeforeQuery/descr.en: A game id; only older games are listed. Pass the previous page's `next`. An empty value counts as absent.
/components/parameters/BeforeQuery/descr.text: Partii ID; loetletakse ainult vanemad partiid. Andke eelmise lehekülje `next`. Tühi väärtus loetakse puuduvaks.

/components/parameters/LimitQuery/descri.en: The page size, 1 to 50. A larger number of up to 3 digits counts as 50; an empty value counts as absent.
/components/parameters/LimitQuery/descri.text: Lehekülje suurus, 1 kuni 50. Suurem, kuni 3-kohaline arv loetakse võrdseks 50-ga; tühi väärtus loetakse puuduvaks.

/components/parameters/LinkTokenQuery/de.en: The token of the e-mail link (43 base64url characters). A missing or wrong one shows the "link invalid or expired" page.
/components/parameters/LinkTokenQuery/de.text: E-posti lingi token (43 base64url-märki). Puuduva või vale tokeni korral näidatakse lehte „link invalid or expired“ (link on kehtetu või aegunud).

/components/headers/CacheControl/descrip.en: Every answer of the server forbids caching.
/components/headers/CacheControl/descrip.text: Serveri iga vastus keelab vahemällu salvestamise.

/components/headers/RetryAfter/descripti.en: Seconds to wait before trying again; the same value as `retryAfter` in the body.
/components/headers/RetryAfter/descripti.text: Sekundid, mida oodata enne uut katset; sama väärtus mis `retryAfter` kehas.

/components/headers/WwwAuthenticate/desc.en: The bearer challenge, with `error="invalid_token"` for an invalid token.
/components/headers/WwwAuthenticate/desc.text: Bearer-väljakutse, kehtetu tokeni korral koos parameetriga `error="invalid_token"`.

/components/headers/ConnectionClose/desc.en: The server closes the connection after this answer.
/components/headers/ConnectionClose/desc.text: Server sulgeb ühenduse pärast seda vastust.

/components/responses/BadRequest/descrip.en: `invalid_request` (with `field` when a field of the body is at fault) or `invalid_json`.
/components/responses/BadRequest/descrip.text: `invalid_request` (koos väljaga `field`, kui viga on keha mõnes väljas) või `invalid_json`.

/components/responses/BadRequest/content.en: A PGN that cannot be read

/components/responses/Unauthorized/descr.en: `unauthorized` (no `Authorization` header) or `invalid_token` (the token is malformed, expired, revoked, or belongs to a deleted account).
/components/responses/Unauthorized/descr.text: `unauthorized` (päist `Authorization` pole) või `invalid_token` (token on vigane, aegunud, tühistatud või kuulub kustutatud kontole).

/components/responses/NotFound/descripti.en: `not_found`, or a feature that this server turned off.
/components/responses/NotFound/descripti.text: `not_found` või funktsioon, mille see server on välja lülitanud.

/components/responses/RequestTimeout/des.en: `request_timeout`: the body did not arrive within 10 seconds. The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/RequestTimeout/des.text: `request_timeout`: keha ei saabunud 10 sekundi jooksul. Server sulgeb ühenduse.

/components/responses/Conflict/descripti.en: The request conflicts with the state of the server.

/components/responses/Gone/description.en: `sso_expired`: the Google sign-in attempt or ticket is unknown, used or expired; start the sign-in again.
/components/responses/Gone/description.text: `sso_expired`: Google'iga sisselogimise katse või pilet on tundmatu, kasutatud või aegunud; alustage sisselogimist uuesti.

/components/responses/PayloadTooLarge/de.en: `payload_too_large`: the body exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (16,384 bytes by default). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/PayloadTooLarge/de.text: `payload_too_large`: keha ületab väärtuse `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (vaikimisi 16 384 baiti). Server sulgeb ühenduse.

/components/responses/UriTooLong/descrip.text: `uri_too_long`: päringu sihtmärk on pikem kui 4096 märki.

/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaTy.en: `unsupported_media_type`: the body is not `application/json`, or its charset is not UTF-8.
/components/responses/UnsupportedMediaTy.text: `unsupported_media_type`: keha pole `application/json` või selle märgistik pole UTF-8.

/components/responses/UnprocessableConte.en: `game_too_long`: the game has more than `GIF_MAX_PLIES` (600) half-moves.

/components/responses/PowRequired/descri.en: `pow_required`: solve the `pow` challenge and send the same request again with `pow: { challenge, nonce }`. `reason` says why: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` or `replayed`.
/components/responses/PowRequired/descri.text: `pow_required`: lahendage väljakutse `pow` ja saatke sama päring uuesti koos väljaga `pow: { challenge, nonce }`. `reason` ütleb põhjuse: `required`, `malformed`, `signature`, `endpoint`, `network`, `expired`, `bits`, `work` või `replayed`.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.en: `rate_limited` (a rate limit, the account budget, or the password hash queue) or `too_many_attempts` (a throttle of the account), with `retryAfter` and a `Retry-After` header.
/components/responses/TooManyRequests/de.text: `rate_limited` (päringute piirang, konto kvoot või paroolide räsimise järjekord) või `too_many_attempts` (konto pidurdus), koos väljaga `retryAfter` ja päisega `Retry-After`.

/components/responses/TooManyRequests/co.en: Too many failures on this account
/components/responses/TooManyRequests/co.text: Sellel kontol on liiga palju ebaõnnestumisi

/components/responses/InternalError/desc.en: `internal_error`: an unexpected failure. The server logs it.

/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.en: `sso_failed`: a wrong `state` or `iss`, or Google refused the code or sent an ID token that does not verify (a code or ID token of the other client, the game's or the website's, included). It never carries Google's text.
/components/responses/BadGateway/descrip.text: `sso_failed`: vale `state` või `iss` või Google lükkas koodi tagasi või saatis ID-tokeni, mis ei läbi kontrolli (sealhulgas teise kliendi – mängu või veebisaidi – kood või ID-token). See ei sisalda kunagi Google'i teksti.

/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.en: `server_busy`, `busy` or `timeout`: try again after `retryAfter` when it is given.
/components/responses/ServiceUnavailable.text: `server_busy`, `busy` või `timeout`: proovige uuesti pärast `retryAfter` sekundit, kui see on antud.

/components/responses/GifFile/descriptio.en: The animated GIF, as an attachment.

/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.en: `attachment; filename="scacelith-<id>.gif"` for a game of this server, `attachment; filename="scacelith-game.gif"` for a PGN sent with `POST /gif`.
/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.text: `attachment; filename="scacelith-<id>.gif"` selle serveri partii puhul, `attachment; filename="scacelith-game.gif"` otspunktiga `POST /gif` saadetud PGN-i puhul.

/components/responses/GifFile/headers/Co.en: The size of the file in bytes.

/components/responses/HtmlBadRequest/des.en: An HTML page that explains the refusal.

/components/responses/HtmlRequestTimeout.en: The form did not arrive within 10 seconds (an HTML page). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/HtmlRequestTimeout.text: Vorm ei saabunud 10 sekundi jooksul (HTML-leht). Server sulgeb ühenduse.

/components/responses/HtmlConflict/descr.en: An HTML page that explains the conflict.

/components/responses/HtmlPayloadTooLarg.en: The form exceeds `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (an HTML page). The server closes the connection.
/components/responses/HtmlPayloadTooLarg.text: Vorm ületab väärtuse `HTTP_BODY_LIMIT` (HTML-leht). Server sulgeb ühenduse.

/components/responses/HtmlUnsupportedMed.en: The body is neither a form (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) nor JSON, or its charset is not UTF-8 (an HTML page).
/components/responses/HtmlUnsupportedMed.text: Keha pole ei vorm (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) ega JSON või selle märgistik pole UTF-8 (HTML-leht).

/components/responses/HtmlTooManyRequest.en: A rate limit (an HTML page), with `Retry-After`.

/components/responses/HtmlInternalError/.en: An unexpected failure (an HTML page titled "Server error"). The server logs it.
/components/responses/HtmlInternalError/.text: Ootamatu tõrge (HTML-leht pealkirjaga „Server error“). Server logib selle.

/components/responses/HtmlServiceUnavail.en: The server is busy (the database stayed locked, or the server is far behind; with `Retry-After`) or took too long (an HTML page titled "Server error").
/components/responses/HtmlServiceUnavail.text: Server on hõivatud (andmebaas jäi lukustatuks või server on tööga kaugele maha jäänud; koos päisega `Retry-After`) või sellel kulus liiga kaua aega (HTML-leht pealkirjaga „Server error“).

/components/schemas/Error/description.en: The one shape of every error answer of the JSON API.
/components/schemas/Error/description.text: JSON API iga veavastuse ainus kuju.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/err.en: The `snake_case` error code. A client chooses what to show from it.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/err.text: Veakood kujul `snake_case`. Klient valib selle põhjal, mida näidata.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/mes.en: An English sentence, meant for logs and as a fallback.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/mes.text: Ingliskeelne lause, mõeldud logide jaoks ja varulahenduseks.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/ret.en: Seconds to wait before trying again, present only on refusals that end with time. The answer then also carries a `Retry-After` header with the same value, except the 503 `busy` of the history, game, player and leaderboard reads.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/ret.text: Sekundid, mida oodata enne uut katset; on olemas ainult tagasilükkamistel, mis aja möödudes lõpevad. Siis on vastuses ka sama väärtusega päis `Retry-After`, välja arvatud ajaloo, partii, mängija ja edetabeli lugemise 503 `busy` korral.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/fie.en: The field or query parameter at fault (`invalid_request`, `invalid_option`, and `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit` and `invalid_filter` of `GET /account/games`). A nested field is dotted (`pow.nonce`).
/components/schemas/Error/properties/fie.text: Väli või päringuparameeter, milles on viga (`invalid_request`, `invalid_option` ning otspunkti `GET /account/games` `invalid_cursor`, `invalid_limit` ja `invalid_filter`). Pesastatud väli kirjutatakse punktidega (`pow.nonce`).

/components/schemas/Error/properties/rea.en: Why: the rule a `weak_password` breaks, or why a proof of work was asked for or refused (`pow_required`).
/components/schemas/Error/properties/rea.text: Põhjus: reegel, mida `weak_password` rikub, või miks töötõendit nõuti või see tagasi lükati (`pow_required`).

/components/schemas/Error/properties/unt.en: `banned` only: the end of the ban (epoch ms), `null` for a permanent ban.
/components/schemas/Error/properties/unt.text: Ainult `banned`: peatamise lõpp (Unixi aeg, ms), alalise peatamise korral `null`.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/lin.en: `invalid_pgn` only: the line of the error, from 1.

/components/schemas/Error/properties/col.en: `invalid_pgn` only: the column of the error, from 1, in characters.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: The signed challenge, to send back as it is.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Allkirjastatud väljakutse, mis tuleb saata tagasi muutmata kujul.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: The number of leading zero bits that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` must have.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Nullbittide arv, millega `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` peab algama.

/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.en: When the challenge expires (epoch ms), 2 minutes after it was issued.
/components/schemas/PowChallenge/propert.text: Millal väljakutse aegub (Unixi aeg, ms): 2 minutit pärast selle väljaandmist.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/descriptio.en: The answer to a proof-of-work challenge.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.en: The `challenge` of the 428 answer, as it was given.
/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.text: Vastuse 428 `challenge` samal kujul, nagu see anti.

/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.en: A decimal string of at most 20 digits such that `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` starts with `bits` zero bits.
/components/schemas/PowAnswer/properties.text: Kuni 20 numbrist koosnev kümnendstring, mille korral `SHA-256(challenge + ":" + nonce)` algab `bits` nullbitiga.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/descripti.en: What a client needs before it signs in or connects.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/descripti.text: Mida klient vajab enne sisselogimist või ühendumist.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The server's name (`SERVER_NAME`).
A UUID that the database gets on its first start. It stays the same across restarts. It is `null` when the database cannot give it.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: UUID, mille andmebaas saab esimesel käivitamisel. See jääb taaskäivitustel samaks. See on `null`, kui andmebaas ei saa seda anda.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The message of the day (`SERVER_MOTD`), possibly empty.
The WebSocket protocol (`PROTOCOL.md`).
The oldest protocol version the server speaks.
The newest protocol version the server speaks.
The fingerprint of the protocol schema (first 4 bytes of the SHA-256 of its canonical form, as an unsigned integer: `0xc649140f`, 3326678031, for protocol minor 2); informational, never compared.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Protokolli skeemi sõrmejälg (selle kanoonilise kuju SHA-256 esimesed 4 baiti märgita täisarvuna: `0xc649140f`, 3326678031, protokolli alamversiooni 2 puhul); informatiivne, seda ei võrrelda kunagi.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The WebSocket subprotocol token (`Sec-WebSocket-Protocol`).
The WebSocket port that players use (`PUBLIC_WS_PORT`, else `WS_PORT`, else `API_PORT`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: WebSocketi port, mida mängijad kasutavad (`PUBLIC_WS_PORT`, muidu `WS_PORT`, muidu `API_PORT`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The path of the WebSocket.
Whether new accounts can be created.
Whether new accounts confirm their address (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Kas uued kontod kinnitavad oma aadressi (`REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: Whether Google sign-in is offered to the game.
Whether Google sign-in is offered to a website too (`POST /auth/sso/google/web/start`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Kas Google'iga sisselogimist pakutakse ka veebisaidile (`POST /auth/sso/google/web/start`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: Two-step verification is always available.
The proof-of-work bits that registration needs (0 for none).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Töötõendi bitid, mida registreerumine nõuab (0, kui ei nõua).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The official (rated) time controls (`RATED_CATEGORIES`), in the server's order. Any other time control is `custom`.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Ametlikud (reitinguga) ajakontrollid (`RATED_CATEGORIES`) serveri järjekorras. Iga muu ajakontroll on `custom`.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The rules a client can check before it sends a form.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Reeglid, mida klient saab kontrollida enne vormi saatmist.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The shortest user name (`USERNAME_MIN`).
The longest user name (`USERNAME_MAX`).
The regular expression a new user name must match.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Regulaaravaldis, millele uus kasutajanimi peab vastama.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The shortest password, in characters (`PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH`).
The longest password, in bytes of UTF-8.
Whether challenges and private games may use custom time controls.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Kas väljakutsetes ja privaatpartiides võib kasutada kohandatud ajakontrolle.

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: How many reports a player may file per 24 hours (`REPORTS_PER_DAY`).
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Mitu teadet võib mängija 24 tunni jooksul esitada (`REPORTS_PER_DAY`).

/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.en: The largest WebSocket message a client may send, in bytes.
/components/schemas/ServerInfo/propertie.text: Suurim WebSocketi sõnum, mida klient võib saata, baitides.

/components/schemas/Category/properties/.en: The category id, minutes and increment seconds (`3+2`).
/components/schemas/Category/properties/.text: Kategooria ID: minutid ja lisaaja sekundid (`3+2`).

/components/schemas/Category/properties/.en: The increment per move, in seconds.

/components/schemas/AccountView/descript.en: The account as its player sees it (`user` of the sign-in answers and of `GET /account/me`).
/components/schemas/AccountView/descript.text: Konto nii, nagu selle mängija seda näeb (sisselogimisvastuste ja otspunkti `GET /account/me` väli `user`).

/components/schemas/AccountView/properti.text: Kas kaheastmeline autentimine on sisse lülitatud.

/components/schemas/AccountView/properti.en: Whether a Google account is linked.
`false` for an account created through Google that has not set a password yet.
/components/schemas/AccountView/properti.text: `false` Google'i kaudu loodud konto puhul, millele pole veel parooli määratud.

/components/schemas/AccountView/properti.en: Whether direct challenges by name are accepted (see `PUT /account/preferences`).
/components/schemas/AccountView/properti.text: Kas otsesed väljakutsed nime järgi võetakse vastu (vt `PUT /account/preferences`).

/components/schemas/AccountView/properti.en: When the account was created (epoch ms).
The new address of an e-mail change waiting for its link, or `null`.
/components/schemas/AccountView/properti.text: Lingi kaudu kinnitamist ootava e-posti aadressi muutmise uus aadress või `null`.

/components/schemas/SessionAnswer/proper.en: The session token, for the `Authorization` header and the WebSocket.
The absolute end of the session (epoch ms); the idle limit may end it sooner.
/components/schemas/SessionAnswer/proper.text: Seansi absoluutne lõpp (Unixi aeg, ms); jõudeoleku piirang võib selle varem lõpetada.

/components/schemas/MfaChallenge/descrip.en: The second step of a sign-in with two-step verification; continue with `POST /auth/login/mfa`.
/components/schemas/MfaChallenge/descrip.text: Kaheastmelise autentimisega sisselogimise teine samm; jätkake otspunktiga `POST /auth/login/mfa`.

/components/schemas/MfaChallenge/propert.en: The token of the step, for `POST /auth/login/mfa`.
Seconds left to complete the step.

/components/schemas/LoginAnswer/descript.en: A session, or the second step of a sign-in with two-step verification.
/components/schemas/LoginAnswer/descript.text: Seanss või kaheastmelise autentimisega sisselogimise teine samm.

/components/schemas/SsoNeedsUsername/des.en: A first Google sign-in; continue with `POST /auth/sso/complete`.

/components/schemas/SsoNeedsUsername/pro.en: The ticket for `POST /auth/sso/complete`, valid for 10 minutes.
A user name made from the Google name or the address, or `""` when nothing fits.
/components/schemas/SsoNeedsUsername/pro.text: Google'i nimest või aadressist tehtud kasutajanimi või `""`, kui miski ei sobi.

/components/schemas/SsoNeedsPassword/des.en: An account with a password uses the address; continue with `POST /auth/sso/google/link`. Nothing is linked yet.
/components/schemas/SsoNeedsPassword/des.text: Aadressi kasutab parooliga konto; jätkake otspunktiga `POST /auth/sso/google/link`. Midagi pole veel seotud.

/components/schemas/SsoNeedsPassword/pro.en: The user name of that account (only someone who proved the address to Google sees it).
/components/schemas/SsoNeedsPassword/pro.text: Selle konto kasutajanimi (seda näeb ainult see, kes on Google'ile aadressi omamist tõendanud).

/components/schemas/SsoStartAnswer/prope.en: The Google URL to open in the system browser, once checked.
/components/schemas/SsoStartAnswer/prope.text: Google'i URL, mis tuleb pärast kontrollimist avada süsteemi brauseris.

/components/schemas/SsoStartAnswer/prope.en: The `state` that Google must send back.

/components/schemas/RegisterRequest/prop.en: The user name; then the server's rules (see the description).
/components/schemas/RegisterRequest/prop.text: Kasutajanimi; seejärel kehtivad serveri reeglid (vt kirjeldust).

/components/schemas/RegisterRequest/prop.en: The e-mail address. Trimmed and stored in lower case.
/components/schemas/RegisterRequest/prop.text: E-posti aadress. Algus- ja lõputühikud eemaldatakse ning see salvestatakse väiketähtedega.

/components/schemas/RegisterRequest/prop.en: The password; then the password rules.

/components/schemas/LoginRequest/propert.en: The user name, or the e-mail address (any text with `@`).
/components/schemas/LoginRequest/propert.text: Kasutajanimi või e-posti aadress (iga tekst, milles on `@`).

/components/schemas/ClientLabel/descript.en: Optional. Shown in the list of signed-in devices (such as `Scacelith 1.4 (Windows)`).

/components/schemas/MfaLoginRequest/prop.en: The `mfaToken` of the sign-in answer (or of a Google sign-in's).
Optional. A 6-digit authenticator code, or a recovery code.
Optional. A recovery code. One of `code` and `recoveryCode` is needed.
/components/schemas/MfaLoginRequest/prop.text: Valikuline. Taastekood. Vaja on üht väljadest `code` ja `recoveryCode`.

/components/schemas/PasswordResetRequest.en: The `token` parameter of the reset link.

/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.en:
A security event. `ip` is given only for what was done while signed in, with the account's password (and second factor) or with a link mailed to its address: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` and `account_exported`; every other kind has `ip: null`, and `ip` is erased after `RETENTION_IP_DAYS`.

`detail` keeps only these fields: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` and `method` (`password`, or `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` and `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. A `moderator_action` event keeps only `{ action }`, for the actions `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` and `revoke_sessions` (the other moderator actions are left out). Every other kind has `detail: null`. The `rating_refund` events are left out: their points are in `ratingRefunds`.
/components/schemas/SecurityEvent/descri.text:
Turvasündmus. `ip` antakse ainult toimingute puhul, mis tehti sisselogituna, konto parooli (ja teise teguriga) või konto aadressile saadetud lingiga: `register`, `email_verified`, `login`, `sso_login`, `sso_linked`, `sso_account_created`, `recovery_code_used`, `password_reset`, `password_changed`, `reauth_failed`, `mfa_setup_started`, `mfa_enabled`, `mfa_disabled`, `recovery_codes_regenerated`, `session_revoked`, `sessions_revoked_all`, `email_change_requested`, `email_changed`, `email_change_refused` ja `account_exported`; kõigil teistel liikidel on `ip: null` ning `ip` kustutatakse pärast aega `RETENTION_IP_DAYS`.

`detail` säilitab ainult need väljad: `login`: `method`; `sso_login`, `sso_account_created`: `provider`; `sso_linked`: `provider` ja `method` (`password` või `password+totp`); `login_failed`: `failures`; `login_lockout`: `retryAfterMs`; `mfa_failed`: `attempts`; `recovery_code_used`: `remaining`; `reauth_failed`: `factor`; `session_revoked` ja `sessions_revoked_all`: `reason`; `email_change_refused`: `reason`; `sanction_auto`: `kind`, `gameId`, `until`. Sündmus `moderator_action` säilitab ainult `{ action }` toimingute `ban`, `unban`, `reset_mfa`, `verify_email` ja `revoke_sessions` puhul (teised moderaatori toimingud jäetakse välja). Kõigil teistel liikidel on `detail: null`. Sündmused `rating_refund` jäetakse välja: nende punktid on väljal `ratingRefunds`.
